description: Large-scale Ridesharing DARP Instances Based on Real Travel Demand (Sydney, Porto) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Dominika Sidlova. This repository contains a collection of large-scale instances for the Dial-a-Ride Problem (DARP), designed as a standardized benchmark for evaluating and comparing various solution approaches in the context of ridesharing. The instances are based on real-world demand data from Porto, Portugal, and Sydney, Australia. Coverage: national (PT); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
